SPEC COMPLIANCE CHUNK FP-10: FHIRPath — §5.6.6-§5.6.12 String Manipulation (Transform). Test these items: upper(), lower(), replace(pattern, substitution), matches(regex), replaceMatches(regex, substitution), length(), toChars(). For DuckDB-backed FHIRPath/CQL surfaces, test both the native/C++ extension path and the Python fallback where both exist, and compare outputs between paths. For SQL-on-FHIR ViewDefinition chunks, test parser validation, SQL generation, DuckDB execution, and official spec fixtures/examples relevant to the chunk.

When the pipeline is fully complete, set workflow to null, set exit_reason, write all handoff files, and return control to the outer spec compliance orchestrator.

issues.evidence: '11/30/1972'.replaceMatches('\\b(?<month>\\d{1,2})/(?<day>\\d{1,2})/(?<year>\\d{2,4})\\b','${day}-${month}-${year}') -> native ([], is_valid=False) vs fallback ['30-11-1972']. Native std::regex cannot parse (?<name>...) and the substitution is passed raw to std::regex_replace (no ${name} support). Spec's own normative example is unrunnable on the native path.
issues.root_cause: std::regex ECMAScript has no named-group syntax and std::regex_replace has no ${name} substitution; the §5.6.10 canonical example was unrunnable natively. Python-side: engine matches() and the udf is_valid regex precheck also rejected (?<name>...) raw.
issues.resolution: Native: normalizeFHIRPathRegex translates (?<name>...) to plain capturing groups (numbering preserved); new fhirpathNamedGroupNumbers + translateNamedGroupSubstitution rewrite ${name} for existing named groups to $N at the fn_replaceMatches site (single-char names fixed). Python: engine matches() uses shared _translate_named_groups (also used by replace_matches, direct helper matches, and udf.py _has_invalid_string_regex_literals). Extension rebuilt + redeployed (repo bundle, user site-packages, ~/.duckdb caches v1.3.0/v1.5.2).
issues.verified_in: Iteration 1 (1774/1774 fhirpath tree; 2832/2832 conformance; 107-case probe → only pinned dialect diffs)

issues.evidence: fhir4ds/fhirpath/duckdb/functions/string.py matches(FHIRPathCollection(['abc']), None) raises TypeError (len(None) in _validate_regex) instead of returning {} like sibling helpers; 6th instance of exported-helper-API family.
issues.root_cause: Direct helper matches() passed the raw regex to _validate_regex which called len(None).
issues.resolution: functions/string.py matches(): None regex -> empty collection; non-String regex -> typed FHIRPathFunctionError via _validate_string_arg.

issues.spec_citation: FHIRPath §5.6.9/§5.6.10 note (dialect not prescribed, PCRE recommended)
issues.evidence: 'ab'.matches('a(?i)B') fallback true vs native empty+is_valid False; 'AB'.matches('(?i:a)b') same; regex-level \uXXXX escape ('caf\\u00E9' pattern text after literal unescape of an escaped backslash) true in Python re, false natively and not default PCRE. std::regex dialect limitation, same family as lookbehind pin.
issues.root_cause: std::regex ECMAScript dialect lacks mid-pattern/scoped flags and \u escapes
issues.resolution: Dialect-sanctioned (std::regex lacks mid-pattern/scoped inline flags and \u escapes; default PCRE also lacks \u). Pinned in test_string_transform_regex_dialect_documented_divergences_fp10_skeptic2 (now with 4 native/fallback pairs incl. lookbehind).
